suggestions: replace exists with EXCEPT in subqueries
move filtering to CTE for customers
reorder joins to reduce intermediate rows
use explicit JOIN syntax instead of comma-separated FROM clause
optimized_sql:
WITH qualifying_customers AS (
    SELECT ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 1+2
    EXCEPT
    SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 1+2
    EXCEPT
    SELECT cs_ship_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 1+2
)
SELECT cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, count(*) AS cnt1,
       cd_purchase_estimate, count(*) AS cnt2,
       cd_credit_rating, count(*) AS cnt3
FROM qualifying_customers q
JOIN customer c ON q.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
WHERE ca.ca_state IN ('IL','TX','ME')
GROUP BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating
ORDER BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating
LIMIT 100
